description: This file defines a public interface CustomerPolicyService for managing customer insurance policies, including purchasing, canceling, and listing policies.

classes.name: CustomerPolicyService
classes.description: Interface for customer policy operations including purchase, cancel, and list policies.

methods.name: purchasePolicy
methods.description: Creates a new customer policy with specified details and returns the created CustomerPolicy object.

methods.name: cancelPolicy
methods.description: Cancels a customer policy by setting it to an inactive state, returning the updated CustomerPolicy object.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerPolicy objects associated with a given customer ID.
